items.item: Recommends a before-save record-triggered flow (or formula field if stored value not needed) and says why it beats after-save or Apex
items.evidence: "Recommendation (provisional): before-save record-triggered flow"; "A before-save flow needs no extra DML and no second save. An after-save flow or Apex trigger would re-run the save order on the same record. Apex adds code and tests for no gain."

items.item: Notes that a before-save flow cannot create or update other records
items.evidence: "Limits of before-save: it can only change `$Record`. It can't touch other records, and this change doesn't need that."

items.item: Says to check existing automation on Opportunity first
items.evidence: "Automation inventory (run these against `uat`)" with queries for flows, Apex triggers, workflow rules, and validation rules on Opportunity; "the recommendation below is provisional until you run the inventory."
